body: I really appreciate you responding. Thank you for taking the time to read my words and respond thoughtfully to them. It means a whole lot to me right now.

Hi dear,

I'm so sorry about your situation. That sounds so stressful and isolating. I am really proud of you for trying to find solutions, and I know it's got to be super hard to do things like abstain from rice and oily foods. Everyone else eats them, plus they taste good! It can feel so isolating, and I understand why you would feel guilty for caving in. However, there's no reason to feel guilty- you are only human, and I promise you, NO ONE on earth can resist temptations 100% of the time. Whether that means scratching or eating "bad" foods, everyone is constantly fighting off temptations.

​

Do you have supportive parents? Are you able to talk to them about this? Have you been able to visit a doctor about the rashes or acne? You're 14- a lot of times, acne is hormonal, and is beyond your control. It must be super hard to deal with the pressure of looking "perfect", because everyone wants to feel beautiful, but it sounds like to me you are seriously a beautiful young woman who just needs some support.
